data.title: QuantumScape launches open platform for sulphide-based solid-state batteries
data.description: The Volkswagen partner has unveiled an open platform for sulphide-based solid-state batteries. It aims to create new licensing and co-development opportunities for existing customers - and allow the integration of third-party components.

data.title: Dacia Sandero electric version expected to achieve around 400 km range
data.description: It has been clear that the next-generation Dacia Sandero will receive a fully electric variant since 2024. Now, according to a British media report, the electric Sandero is expected to be based on the "RGMP Small" platform and offer a range of around 400 kilometers. The release year is rumored to be 2028.

data.title: Kia to invest around €1.8 billion in new plant in India
data.description: The South Korean automaker Kia plans to build a second vehicle plant in India, which, like the first factory, will be located in Anantapur in the state of Andhra Pradesh. The facility is expected to produce up to 200,000 vehicles annually — both electric cars and internal combustion engine vehicles.

data.title: Daimler Buses Italia to supply TUA Abruzzo with 40 new electric buses
data.description: Daimler Buses Italia and STI, an Italian energy and charging infrastructure service provider, have won the tender of regional transport operator TUA Abruzzo in Italy. The order includes 40 electric low-floor city buses with an option for eight additional vehicles, as well as the responsibility for setting up the necessary charging infrastructure at TUA's depot on Via Aterno in Pescara.

data.title: Hyundai explores investment in Posco graphite project in Vietnam
data.description: Hyundai Motor Group is considering an investment in Posco Future M's planned synthetic graphite business in Vietnam. The proposed investment is 100 billion won, (around 67.6 million euros). In return, Hyundai is to receive preferred purchasing rights for the anode material.

data.title: VW launches the ID. ERA 5X in China with pricing
data.description: The VW ID. ERA 5X costs around 13,530 euros in China at market launch and offers more interior space than a VW ID. Tiguan despite its smaller dimensions. This is made possible by the new Compact Main Platform, which debuts with the ID. ERA 5X. The China SUV can also be equipped with partially automated assistance systems.

data.title: VW’s Scout brand begins production of first test vehicles at new US plant
data.description: Volkswagen's revived US brand Scout has begun assembling the first validation vehicles at its new plant in Blythewood, South Carolina. As the factory is still under construction, it will be several more months before Scout vehicles are running off production lines in series.

data.title: Northumberland to sport 36 more public charge points
data.description: A new suite of electric vehicle chargers is being added to Northumberland County Council's existing network. The Council has passed a motion to add an additional 36 EV charging points at 26 locations. The picturesque coastal region in the Northeast of England, borders Scotland and is famous for being home to Hadrian's wall and the Northumberland National Park.

data.title: India: Bihar Police to deploy 1,100 electric motorcycles
data.description: The police department of Bihar, a state in the eastern part of India, plans to deploy 1,100 electric motorcycles for patrolling operations. It has ordered these vehicles from Revolt Motors, one of the few electric motorcycle manufacturers in the country.

data.title: UK funds project for recovering nickel, cobalt and copper
data.description: ReOre Technologies, an Altilium Group company focused on recovering critical minerals from mining waste, has announced it will lead a new UK government-backed project to unlock domestic supplies of nickel, cobalt and copper. For the two-year Cascade project, ReOre is collaborating with project partners Aberdeen Minerals and Camborne School of Mines, supported by the Battery Innovation Programme.

data.title: British Gas orders nearly 2,000 VW Transporters, some of which are electric
data.description: Volkswagen Commercial Vehicles has delivered 1,986 new transporters to British Gas. The fleet includes both electric Transporters and diesel models. The companies have not disclosed the number of purely electric vehicles.

data.title: Mercedes board threatens to close German plants and stop investments in Germany
data.description: Mercedes-Benz is temporarily halting its investments in Germany and putting plants up for sale. The move is a response by management to the protracted negotiations with the union over what Mercedes says are excessively high labor costs. The company's board insists on cuts to keep German production competitive.

data.title: Lucid Air Grand Touring: a long-distance champion with plenty of power
data.description: For two weeks, we travelled with this luxury sedan from California. The Lucid Air impresses with its long-distance capability, an extremely quiet interior, and intuitive controls. However, it also has a few weaknesses that shouldn’t exist at this price point.

data.title: DPD UK expands electric fleet with 381 new Fords from November
data.description: DPD UK is further expanding its electric fleet. After 341 new Mercedes-Benz eSprinters already entered service with the delivery company in September 2026, DPD UK has now also ordered 381 Ford E-Transits. The electric vans are expected to be deployed starting mid-November.

data.title: UK depot charging scheme reopens – with reduced funding rate
data.description: The UK Government has reopened applications for the section round of its Depot Charging Scheme, which provides funding for businesses installing charging infrastructure for electric vans and HGVs. However, the grant rate has been reduced from 70 to 60 per cent of eligible costs.

data.title: VW ID. Tiguan enters series production
data.description: Just a few weeks after the unveiling of the VW ID. Tiguan, Volkswagen has now started series production of the electric SUV at its Emden plant. Although the vehicle will not be available at dealerships until early 2027, thousands of pre-orders have already been placed.

data.title: India: Olectra deploys 35 electric buses in Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar
data.description: Indian electric commercial vehicle manufacturer Olectra Greentech Limited, a subsidiary of Megha Engineering and Infrastructures Limited (MEIL), has commissioned 35 electric buses in Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar, a city in the western state of Maharashtra. The new buses serve the city's public transport fleet.

data.title: Smatrics EnBW deploys first XCharge charger with 480 kW in Austria
data.description: Smatrics EnBW has opened a new fast-charging location in Vienna with eight charging points. There, the operator is using XCharge's new C7 generation for the first time in Austria, offering charging power of up to 480 kW.

data.title: Fraunhofer IFAM researches e-motors with fewer critical raw materials
data.description: Fraunhofer IFAM is building new research infrastructure in Dresden for electric motors that are designed to use fewer critical raw materials. The SIREN project focuses on, among other things, drives without rare earth elements and aluminium as a substitute for copper in the windings.

data.title: Tozero announces first delivery of recycled lithium carbonate to customers
data.description: The German lithium-ion battery recycling startup Tozero has delivered its first recycled lithium carbonate to an industrial customer, Botz GmbH. The material was produced at Tozero's new demonstration plant in the Gendorf Chemical Park near Munich.
